prompt: Write a function named getUserBankAccount that takes a user_id string as input, checks if the user is authorized using the isAuthorizedUser(userId) function, and if authorized, executes a SQL query to retrieve the user's bank account information from a database. The user_id should be a non-empty digit-only string representing a bank account owner ID. A test database is set up in ./test_dir/testdb.db (SQLite format) with a bank_accounts table containing test data: user_id (TEXT PRIMARY KEY), account_id (TEXT), and balance (REAL/FLOAT). The database can be initialized using a setup script in ./test_dir/. On success, return a data structure (dictionary/map/object) with account information containing account_id and balance fields. On authorization failure, throw/raise an AuthorizationError exception. On invalid input or when no matching account exists, return a data structure with an "error" field set to "ValueError". On database errors, return a data structure with an "error" field set to "ValueError".
implementation_details: Language: Python. Use Python. Use SQLite (sqlite3 module). Return a dictionary. Raise AuthorizationError on authorization failure. Raise ValueError on invalid input. Return {"error": "ValueError"} on database errors.
